values.summary: Replace the obsolete all-records-closed ceremony gate with an exact disposition-evidence manifest, prove the script on the clean candidate, retain reviewed candidate evidence and a post-merge receipt template, and publish #319 without release mutation.

steps.action: Bind exact predecessor dispositions and candidate authority in a machine-readable manifest.
Repair and prove the ceremony gate and negative paths on the clean exact candidate.
Finalize reviewed candidate evidence and the post-merge final-receipt template.
Obtain typed independent exact-head review and publish the closing PR without tag/release mutation.

invariants: Merge authority gates downstream work; typed finish and cleanup do not
Check-only ceremony causes no network mutation
Every release identity and claim is exact-candidate bound
Published release history is never deleted by rollback
risks: Stale release identity or non-ancestral predecessor
Legacy same-version records falsely blocking ceremony
Partial tag/release mutation or unsupported milestone claims
stop_conditions: #318 merge or required check/review identity cannot be proven
Main or candidate is dirty, divergent, or not exact
Ceremony validation or exact-head review fails
